about.body:
Three days of royal heritage, serene lakes, hidden viewpoints and timeless Rajasthan. Udaipur does not rush anyone, and neither does this spell.

**This is not about ticking places off a list.** It is about palaces at golden hour, boats that take their time, and an old city that teaches you to walk slower.

- Overnight AC traveller from Delhi on both ends
- Two nights in Udaipur, breakfasts and a farewell dinner included
- City Palace, Saheliyon Ki Bari, the Spellbound island escape and Chittorgarh
about.quote: Collect sunsets, stories and memories worth keeping.

itinerary.body:
Arrive at your stay, settle in and ease into the Udaipur mood with a relaxed breakfast. Then step into the royal legacy at **City Palace**: grand courtyards, ornate balconies and spectacular views over Lake Pichola.

At the historic **Jagdish Temple**, intricate carvings and towering architecture slow you down. **Bagore Ki Haveli** follows with an enchanting traditional Rajasthani puppet show, and the old city's market lanes and ghats carry you into the evening. Dinner is by the water, with Udaipur glowing across it.
itinerary.title: Royal Heritage & Old Udaipur
itinerary.subtitle: Where the story begins

highlights.text: Puppet show at Bagore Ki Haveli

itinerary.body:
Wake up to peaceful views, fresh air and the quiet beauty of the Aravalli hills. After breakfast, take a scenic stroll along **Fateh Sagar Lake**, then wander **Saheliyon Ki Bari**, the historic royal garden of fountains, flowers and timeless charm.

Then comes **Spellbound**: set sail across the lake and escape to a peaceful island, a beautiful pause surrounded by water, views and good company. The rest of the day is yours, cafes, conversations and little unplanned moments, before the slower rhythm sinks in back at the property.
itinerary.title: Lakes, Gardens & Mountain Mornings
itinerary.subtitle: The softer side of Udaipur

itinerary.body:
Breakfast, check-out and one last chapter. The peaceful hilltop **Karni Mata Temple** opens the day with beautiful views over Udaipur before the road turns towards the legendary city of Chittorgarh.

At **Chittorgarh Fort**, monumental walls, ancient gateways and grand palaces carry the stories of Rajasthan's legendary past. Stay for the **fort sunset**, golden light washing over the ramparts, then begin the overnight drive back to Delhi carrying stories, photographs and new friendships.
itinerary.title: Temples, Forts & the Journey Home
itinerary.subtitle: One last taste of Rajasthan
